scenes.title: Hotel Stars and Strange Dollars
scenes.summary: While Hotel Eleon prepares for a star-rating inspection, a guest tricks Nastya into accepting paper napkins as dollars.

scenes.title: A Hypnotist in the Hotel
scenes.summary: Vika realizes a hypnotist fraudster tricked Nastya, but Mikhail refuses to call the police while the star commission is present.

scenes.title: Drunk Nagiyev and the Commission
scenes.summary: Nagiyev gets drunk over a football loss, forcing Mikhail and Chef Barinov to hide him from the arriving hotel inspectors.

scenes.title: The Deleted Database at Reception
scenes.summary: Max and Kostya search for the suspect at reception just as the real hypnotist makes Sveta delete the hotel computer database.

scenes.title: Inspecting the Rooms
scenes.summary: The commission chairwoman deducts points for hallway width and housekeeping before discovering a luxury suite is occupied.

scenes.title: Nagiyev in the Suite
scenes.summary: The inspectors stumble upon drunk Nagiyev drinking in the luxury suite, and Mikhail scrambles to usher them out.

scenes.title: The Golden Rule of the Hotel
scenes.summary: Mikhail denies that a bellboy was drinking with the guest and orders Vika to put a sober employee at the post before the inspector checks.

scenes.title: The Sketch and the Capture Plan
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov sends Nagiyev away in a taxi, while Max and Kostya spot the moustached man and plan to lure him out.

scenes.title: Do Not Look into His Eyes
scenes.summary: Max tries to lure the moustached man out of the dining room without looking into his eyes and then grabs him as the fraudster.

scenes.title: The Fall on the Stairs
scenes.summary: Inspector Pavel Vladimirovich tries to stop Mikhail from shaking drunk Nagiyev and accidentally tumbles down the stairs.

scenes.title: A Doctor Is Needed Urgently
scenes.summary: Mikhail asks Chef Barinov for an discrete doctor after the inspector is knocked unconscious, while Max tapes their prisoner's eyes shut.

scenes.title: We Grabbed the Wrong Man
scenes.summary: Vika discovers that the moustached man Max and Kostya tied up is actually an inspector from the hotel commission.

scenes.title: Fake Doctor Senya
scenes.summary: Senya dresses up as a doctor and scares Mikhail with a fake diagnosis so they can hide the unconscious inspector in Mikhail's office.

scenes.title: Hush Money and a Cocktail
scenes.summary: Senya demands hush money from Mikhail, while a female guest orders a Sex on the Beach cocktail in the restaurant.

scenes.title: The Real Hypnotist
scenes.summary: Max deduces from the cocktail order that the female guest is the real hypnotist who framed the moustached man.

scenes.title: The Commission's Verdict and Max's Trance
scenes.summary: The chairwoman gives the hotel three stars while Chef Barinov puppets the unconscious inspector, and the hypnotist puts Max under her spell.

scenes.title: Max Under Hypnosis
scenes.summary: Hypnotized by the female con artist, Max returns to the bar claiming she paid with real money and tells Kostya and Nastya to let her go.

scenes.title: Arguing for Five Stars
scenes.summary: Mikhail begs the chairwoman for five stars right as the injured inspector wakes up and walks into the lobby, exposing their ruse.

scenes.title: The Trap in the Hotel Room
scenes.summary: Vika catches the female hypnotist robbing a guest room, and the con artist uses a hypnotized Max to fight off Kostya.

scenes.title: Five Stars for Friendship and Love
scenes.summary: Vika stops the hypnotist herself, and Max reflects that while hotels are rated by stars, friendship and love cannot be measured.
